name: Ray Marching with Depth Testing
definition: Visualizes volumes by casting rays from the camera and sampling at discrete steps along each ray's path, traversing a voxel grid and applying transfer functions to map raw values to color and opacity.
summary: Ray Marching with Depth Testing visualizes volumes by casting rays and sampling a voxel grid, distinguishing itself by discarding samples behind opaque objects to ensure correct occlusion with solid geometry.
